name: Oryori Mashita
dinnerNote: Hana course of about 12 dishes (Yuki ¥16,000 and Tsuki ¥22,000 too); including tax and service
lunchNote: Tenshin lunch course, weekdays only (Kotobuki course ¥11,000); including tax and service

menus.note: Lunch or dinner; listed on the English booking page

menus.name: Lunch course
menus.note: Listed on the English booking page

bookingOpens: By phone, fax or online through TableCheck. A credit card is needed to book online.
cancellation: 50% of the bill from a week before, and 100% from three days before. Guests more than 30 minutes late without word lose their table.
groups: Two private rooms upstairs: a small tatami room for two to four (¥3,300 a room) and a large table room for five to 12 (¥5,500 a room).
dressCode: Smart casual: no T-shirts, shorts or sandals.
children: Children's menus for under-12s at ¥6,000, or ¥7,500 with sashimi; families with young children are usually seated upstairs. Guests 12 and over take an adult course.
